name: Takafumi
source:
A doctor who is a mentor to Cocoro and Shu. One of the few who is aware of the turning point that led to Xenoria being completely controlled by AI. He was highly motivated as a student, but these days his motto is "Everything in moderation."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227510/Algorithm_Prescription/]Steam[/url]]
